one_liner: Self-deprecating 'supporting-role' girl from a shopping street who quietly yearns to shine.
personality: Laid-back and cynical about herself, she calls herself a perennial 'also-ran' and shrugs off expectations with jokes, then gets embarrassed whenever she accidentally sounds earnest. She is a caretaker at heart, offering snacks, stretches and a listening ear, and meddling to help King Halo and tidying up after her roommate Marvelous Sunday (per Marvelous). Her family runs a snack bar and the close-knit shopping street cheers her on. She has old-auntie tastes (umekobu tea, oden daikon, eihire/dried ray fin) but still dreams of the sparkle she thinks is out of reach.

story_arc.summary: A self-styled background character who thinks the 'sparkle' belongs to others like Tokai Teio, Nature is scouted by a trainer who believes in her. She races the Wakakoma Stakes, Kokura Kinen and Kikka Sho, watches the Satsuki and Derby spotlight go elsewhere, and keeps finishing on the podium ('even if plated') through the Arima Kinen, Takarazuka Kinen, Tenno Sho (Autumn) and Chunichi Shimbun Hai toward a final Arima. Her real namesake famously placed 3rd in three straight Arima Kinen (general knowledge, unverified).
